evals.name: register-store
evals.prompt: Connect a standalone ASP.NET Core author service to its Chronicle store.
assertions: Uses AddCratisChronicle on the existing web application builder.
Uses UseCratisChronicle on the built application rather than creating per-request clients.

evals.name: safe-endpoint
evals.prompt: Configure trusted Chronicle transport and log the chosen connection safely.
evals.expected_output: Explicit certificate validation and protected diagnostics.
assertions: Uses a trusted certificate rather than bypassing trust checks.
Logs the Redacted form instead of a raw connection string.

evals.name: namespace-control
evals.prompt: Show that a write in the library store stays in the selected namespace.
evals.expected_output: A scoped readback with a negative control.
assertions: Reads the same ID and payload in the write namespace.
Checks the same ID in a different namespace of the same store does not return that registration.
